message: Scaled 1 of 3 spindle speeds to 50 %; 2 tapping speeds left as written.

findings.message: S500 is the speed in force when the tapping block on line 5 (CYCL DEF 207) runs. A tap's feed follows from its speed and its pitch, so the speed is left as written: scaled on its own it would break the tap. Change the speed and the feed together by hand if the tap should run at another speed.

S2000 is the speed in force when the tapping block on line 30 (CYCL DEF 207) runs. A tap's feed follows from its speed and its pitch, so the speed is left as written: scaled on its own it would break the tap. Change the speed and the feed together by hand if the tap should run at another speed.
